scripts.dev: node scripts/env.mjs sync && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run worker:supervised"
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/env.mjs run -- npm run --workspace=@fhara/api dev
scripts.worker:supervised: node scripts/supervise.mjs --name worker --cwd packages/worker -- npx tsx src/index.ts
scripts.convex: npm run --workspace=@fhara/api codegen --silent && concurrently -k -n api,worker "npm run --workspace=@fhara/api dev" "npm run worker"
scripts.migrate:github-global: node scripts/env.mjs run -- npm run --workspace=@fhara/api migrate:github-global
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/env.mjs sync && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker,app -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run worker:supervised" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=@fhara/web typecheck && npm run --workspace=@fhara/api typecheck && npm run --workspace=@fhara/worker typecheck
scripts.check:guards: npm run check:budget && npm run check:cycles
